svg.title: A spring-launched toy car on two possible paths
svg.desc: A compressed spring launches a toy race car to the right along a level track. The path of the car curves gently upward and levels off h = 18 cm above its starting level. An alternate path first dips down, goes around a vertical loop, and then climbs to the same level, 18 cm above the start. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Mechanical energy depends on height, not the route
Compare at equal heights: same speed
Equal-height comparison (not equal-time motion). Blue: kinetic energy; gold: gravitational energy.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
